newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Tea Factories dips 8.3 pct on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Tea Factories dips 8.3 pct on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares of Tea Smallholder Factories Ltd fell 8.33 percent or three rupees to 33, on profit-taking in early Friday trade, brokers said.
"Retailers are taking profit in the share which is a stock favoured by them" said a broker who declined to be identified.
The share is a favourite beause it is cheap, liquid and in the plantation sector which is expected to see good growth in 1997 on continuing demand for Sri Lanka tea, he said.
The company processes tea leaf bought from small cultivators.
